name: infocyph/webrick
description: A fast, modern PHP router with production-grade middleware, signed & temporary URLs, smart responses and first-class route caching.

suggest.infocyph/cachelayer: Required by response-cache middleware and the CacheLayer atomic-counter adapter.
suggest.open-telemetry/exporter-otlp: Export traces to OpenTelemetry collectors (Jaeger, Zipkin, etc.)
suggest.open-telemetry/sdk: Full OpenTelemetry tracing with automatic span export (auto-detected by TelemetryMiddleware)
suggest.opis/closure: Required only when compiling route or middleware Closures into persistent artifacts through InterMix.
suggest.psr/http-factory: Optional PSR-17 factories for Webrick's explicit PSR-7 interoperability bridge.
suggest.psr/http-message: Optional PSR-7 message interfaces for interoperability adapters.
